fields.Name: ConsentModel
fields.Description: Governs whether explicit opt-in consent is required or opt-out applies. Strictest merge: opt-in beats opt-out; softOptIn is false unless all regimes allow it.

fields.Name: RequireDoubleOptIn
fields.Description: Requires confirmed double opt-in (OptInMethod = Double and ConfirmedAt set). Strictest merge: true wins.

fields.Name: ConsentEvidence
fields.Description: Requires recorded consent evidence fields (source, timestamp, consent text). Strictest merge: true wins per field.

fields.Name: ConsentExpiry
fields.Description: Enforces a maximum age (in days) for consent before renewal is required. Strictest merge: shortest maxDays wins.

fields.Name: UnsubscribeMechanism
fields.Description: Requires one-click List-Unsubscribe header and/or visible footer unsubscribe link. Strictest merge: required beats optional.

fields.Name: UnsubscribeHonorWindow
fields.Description: Maximum hours allowed to honor an unsubscribe request, driving SLA monitoring. Strictest merge: shortest maxHours wins.

fields.Name: SenderIdentification
fields.Description: Requires physical postal address and clear sender name in outbound messages. Strictest merge: true wins per field.

fields.Name: QuietHours
fields.Description: Defers sends that fall inside legal quiet-hour local-time windows. Strictest merge: union of all blocked windows wins.

fields.Name: TrackingConsent
fields.Description: Controls whether open-tracking pixels and click/link rewriting require explicit consent. Strictest merge: true wins per field.
